title: Dog Walking
excerpt: Small group walks of no more than 4 dogs, plus puppy visits with a short walk, play and a little training at home.
intro: Group walks in small groups of no more than 4 dogs, so your dog makes friends and gets extra stimulation. With your permission, and after an assessment on their first walk, dogs can go off lead in public areas. Dogs without reliable recall use our secure local fields and woodland instead, so every dog gets the most out of their walk.
highlights: Small groups of no more than 4 dogs
Off-lead only with your permission and after an assessment walk
Secure local fields and woodland for dogs still working on recall
Puppy visits with a short walk, play or basic training, and any accidents cleaned up
Key holding at no extra charge
Insured with Petplan Sanctuary. DBS-checked walkers
pricingNote: All prices include VAT. Walk and daycare cancellations need 48 hours' notice, otherwise a 50% fee applies. Bank holidays, Christmas and New Year are charged at double rate.
